label: rem:categorical-boson-fermion
title: Categorical distinction between bosons and fermions
html: The Schur--Weyl decomposition V^{\otimes 3} \cong V_{\frac{3}{2}} \oplus V_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\oplus 2} separates the symmetric (spin-\frac{3}{2}) and mixed-symmetry (spin-\frac{1}{2}) sectors. The B_3-action preserves this decomposition. On the symmetric sector, the generators act as scalars, producing bosonic exchange. On the mixed-symmetry sector, they act non-trivially, producing fermionic exchange. This categorical distinction between bosons and fermions requires no topological input.
